skill.summary: Deploy and run Konto (personal finance dashboard) locally. Use when setting up a new Konto instance, troubleshooting installation, or helping users get start...

latestVersion.changelog:
Konto skill v1.1.0 — now provides API querying for live personal finance data.

- Redesigned skill to use API keys and direct API calls for live data queries.
- Added comprehensive API usage examples for common finance questions.
- Introduced a helper shell script (`scripts/konto.sh`) for quick command-line access to key endpoints.
- Added new documentation files: `api.md` and `_meta.json`.
- Updated instructions and scope details to clarify setup and personal usage.
